name: Ursule Fleur Jeanmaire
original_name: ユルシュール＝フルール＝ジャンメール
source:
Hometown: Geneva, Switzerland

[url=/c9482]Luna[/url]'s childhood friend but also her self-declared rival. Highly proud of her abilities and noble background, but also very easily deceived by Luna and her own maid [url=/c9488]Sasha[/url].

[spoiler]Despite what her arrogant nature suggests, she is actually very emotionally fragile and has to work very hard to keep up with Luna as she lacks her natural talent.[/spoiler]
